verdict.rationale: BigCommerce has a dedicated B2B solutions page claiming customer-specific pricing and business-buyer workflows, indicating a real B2B/wholesale offering, but the evidence is only marketing copy with no detail on quotes, net-terms invoicing, or volume pricing mechanics, and no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documentation of specific B2B features like price lists, volume pricing tiers, quote workflows, net-terms invoicing, and any community/hands-on validation of these B2B capabilities.
